## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.DataAccess/Sql/001_ReducePlayerRegistrationLengths.sql
````sql
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @playersId int = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Players', N'U');
    IF @playersId IS NULL
        THROW 50001, 'dbo.Players does not exist in the selected database.', 1;

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Players', N'Username') = 40 AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Players', N'Email') = 140
    BEGIN
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF ISNULL(COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Players', N'Username'), 0) <> 64
        OR ISNULL(COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Players', N'Email'), 0) <> 240
        THROW 50002, 'Expected the original Players column lengths (32 and 120).', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Players WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE DATALENGTH(Username) > 40 OR DATALENGTH(Email) > 140
    )
        THROW 50003, 'Existing accounts exceed the new lengths. Resolve them before rerunning this script.', 1;

    DECLARE @usernameConstraint sysname;
    DECLARE @emailConstraint sysname;

    SELECT
        @usernameConstraint = MAX(CASE WHEN columns.name = N'Username' THEN constraints.name END),
        @emailConstraint = MAX(CASE WHEN columns.name = N'Email' THEN constraints.name END)
    FROM sys.key_constraints AS constraints
    INNER JOIN sys.index_columns AS keys
        ON keys.object_id = constraints.parent_object_id AND keys.index_id = constraints.unique_index_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns AS columns
        ON columns.object_id = keys.object_id AND columns.column_id = keys.column_id
    WHERE constraints.parent_object_id = @playersId
        AND constraints.type = 'UQ'
        AND keys.key_ordinal = 1
        AND columns.name IN (N'Username', N'Email')
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.index_columns AS remainingKeys
            WHERE remainingKeys.object_id = keys.object_id AND remainingKeys.index_id = keys.index_id
                AND remainingKeys.key_ordinal > 1
        );

    IF @usernameConstraint IS NULL OR @emailConstraint IS NULL OR @usernameConstraint = @emailConstraint
        THROW 50004, 'Expected separate unique constraints for Players.Username and Players.Email.', 1;

    DECLARE @usernameIndexExists bit = 0;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = @playersId AND name = N'IX_Players_Username')
    BEGIN
        SET @usernameIndexExists = 1;
        DROP INDEX IX_Players_Username ON dbo.Players;
    END;

    DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max) = N'ALTER TABLE dbo.Players DROP CONSTRAINT '
        + QUOTENAME(@usernameConstraint) + N', ' + QUOTENAME(@emailConstraint);
    EXEC sys.sp_executesql @sql;

    ALTER TABLE dbo.Players ALTER COLUMN Username nvarchar(20) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.Players ALTER COLUMN Email nvarchar(70) NOT NULL;

    SET @sql = N'ALTER TABLE dbo.Players ADD CONSTRAINT '
        + QUOTENAME(@usernameConstraint) + N' UNIQUE (Username), CONSTRAINT '
        + QUOTENAME(@emailConstraint) + N' UNIQUE (Email)';
    EXEC sys.sp_executesql @sql;

    IF @usernameIndexExists = 1
        CREATE INDEX IX_Players_Username ON dbo.Players (Username);

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    THROW;
END CATCH;
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.DataAccess/Sql/README.md
````markdown
# SQL Server schema updates

Run `001_ReducePlayerRegistrationLengths.sql` against the existing Vértigo database
before deploying the registration update. For a fresh database, load the team's
base schema first. The script expects `dbo.Players` with separate unique constraints
on `Username` and `Email`.

The script keeps existing accounts and stops if any value exceeds the new column
capacity. To find the affected accounts, run this query in the same database.

```sql
SELECT PlayerId, DATALENGTH(Username) / 2 AS UsernameLength, DATALENGTH(Email) / 2 AS EmailLength
FROM dbo.Players
WHERE DATALENGTH(Username) > 40 OR DATALENGTH(Email) > 140;
```

Resolve those accounts before rerunning the script. A successful run changes the
columns to `nvarchar(20)` and `nvarchar(70)` and preserves uniqueness. A second run
against the updated schema exits successfully.
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.DataAccess/DependencyInjection.cs
````csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Contexts;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Implementations;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;

namespace Vertigo.Server.DataAccess;

public static class DependencyInjection
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddVertigoDataAccess(
        this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        string connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("VertigoDb")
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Connection string 'VertigoDb' is missing.");

        services.AddDbContext<VertigoDatabaseContext>(options => options.UseSqlServer(connectionString));
        services.AddScoped<IPlayerRepository, PlayerRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IFriendshipRepository, FriendshipRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IBlockedPlayerRepository, BlockedPlayerRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ISessionTokenRepository, SessionTokenRepository>();

        return services;
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.Host/Logging/README.md
````markdown
# Límites del logging del servidor

Los destinos Technical y Security escriben archivos JSONL mediante Serilog.

- Un fallo de almacenamiento o una interrupción del proceso puede provocar la pérdida de registros.
- Si se interrumpe una escritura, la última línea del JSONL puede quedar parcial.
- La retención se mide por cantidad de archivos. Technical conserva hasta 30 y Security hasta 60.
- Ambos destinos rotan por día y por tamaño. El umbral de 10 MiB por archivo es aproximado y un evento puede sobrepasarlo.
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.Host/Logging/ServerLoggingConfiguration.cs
````csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Serilog;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Debugging;
using Serilog.Events;
using Serilog.Formatting.Json;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Host.Logging;

internal static class ServerLoggingConfiguration
{
    private static int _diagnosticCount;

    public static Logger CreateLogger(IConfiguration configuration, IHostEnvironment environment)
    {
        string directory = GetBaseDirectory(configuration, environment.ContentRootPath);
        string technicalDirectory = Path.Combine(directory, "Technical");
        string securityDirectory = Path.Combine(directory, "Security");
        LogEventLevel technicalLevel = GetLevel(configuration, LoggingSettings.TechnicalMinimumLevelKey,
            LogEventLevel.Warning);
        LogEventLevel frameworkLevel = GetLevel(configuration, LoggingSettings.FrameworkMinimumLevelKey,
            environment.IsDevelopment() ? LogEventLevel.Information : LogEventLevel.Warning);
        bool consoleEnabled = configuration.GetValue(LoggingSettings.ConsoleEnabledKey, environment.IsDevelopment());
        LogEventLevel consoleLevel = LogEventLevel.Information;
        if (technicalLevel < consoleLevel)
        {
            consoleLevel = technicalLevel;
        }
        LogEventLevel rootLevel = consoleLevel < frameworkLevel ? consoleLevel : frameworkLevel;

        SelfLog.Enable(ReportInternalFailure);
        LoggerConfiguration loggerConfiguration = new LoggerConfiguration()
            .MinimumLevel.Is(rootLevel)
            .MinimumLevel.Override("Microsoft", frameworkLevel)
            .MinimumLevel.Override("System", frameworkLevel)
            .Enrich.FromLogContext();

        bool technicalAvailable = TryCreateDirectory(technicalDirectory);
        if (technicalAvailable)
        {
            technicalAvailable = TryConfigureTechnicalFile(loggerConfiguration, technicalDirectory, technicalLevel);
        }

        if (!technicalAvailable)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("Technical log destination unavailable; using stderr for technical events.");
        }

        if (consoleEnabled || !technicalAvailable)
        {
            LogEventLevel minimumLevel = technicalAvailable ? consoleLevel : technicalLevel;
            loggerConfiguration.WriteTo.Logger(technical => technical
                .Filter.ByExcluding(IsSecurityEvent)
                .Filter.ByIncludingOnly(logEvent => logEvent.Level >= minimumLevel)
                .WriteTo.Console(standardErrorFromLevel: LogEventLevel.Verbose));
        }

        if (TryCreateDirectory(securityDirectory))
        {
            TryConfigureSecurityFile(loggerConfiguration, securityDirectory);
        }
        else
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("Security log destination unavailable; security events may be missing.");
        }

        return loggerConfiguration.CreateLogger();
    }

    private static bool TryConfigureTechnicalFile(
        LoggerConfiguration configuration, string directory, LogEventLevel minimumLevel)
    {
        bool success = true;
        string path = Path.Combine(directory, "technical-.jsonl");

        try
        {
            configuration.WriteTo.Logger(technical => technical
                .Filter.ByExcluding(IsSecurityEvent)
                .Filter.ByIncludingOnly(logEvent => logEvent.Level >= minimumLevel)
                .WriteTo.File(
                    new JsonFormatter(renderMessage: true), path,
                    rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
                    fileSizeLimitBytes: LoggingSettings.MaximumFileSizeBytes,
                    rollOnFileSizeLimit: true,
                    retainedFileCountLimit: LoggingSettings.TechnicalRetainedFileCount));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or ArgumentException)
        {
            success = false;
        }

        return success;
    }

    private static void TryConfigureSecurityFile(LoggerConfiguration configuration, string directory)
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(directory, "security-.jsonl");

        try
        {
            configuration.WriteTo.Logger(security => security
                .Filter.ByIncludingOnly(IsSecurityEvent)
                .WriteTo.File(
                    new JsonFormatter(renderMessage: true), path,
                    rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
                    fileSizeLimitBytes: LoggingSettings.MaximumFileSizeBytes,
                    rollOnFileSizeLimit: true,
                    retainedFileCountLimit: LoggingSettings.SecurityRetainedFileCount));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or ArgumentException)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("Security log destination unavailable; security events may be missing.");
        }
    }

    private static bool TryCreateDirectory(string directory)
    {
        bool success = true;

        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or ArgumentException
                                   or NotSupportedException)
        {
            success = false;
        }

        return success;
    }

    private static string GetBaseDirectory(IConfiguration configuration, string contentRootPath)
    {
        string? configuredDirectory = configuration[LoggingSettings.DirectoryKey];
        string directory = Path.Combine(
            Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
            "Vertigo", "Server", "Logs");

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredDirectory))
        {
            if (Path.IsPathRooted(configuredDirectory))
            {
                directory = Path.GetFullPath(configuredDirectory);
            }
            else
            {
                directory = Path.GetFullPath(configuredDirectory, contentRootPath);
            }
        }

        return directory;
    }

    private static LogEventLevel GetLevel(
        IConfiguration configuration, string key, LogEventLevel defaultLevel)
    {
        LogEventLevel level = defaultLevel;
        string? configured = configuration[key];

        if (Enum.TryParse(configured, true, out LogEventLevel parsed) && Enum.IsDefined(parsed))
        {
            level = parsed;
        }

        return level;
    }

    private static bool IsSecurityEvent(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        bool isSecurity = false;

        if (logEvent.Properties.TryGetValue(LoggingSettings.EventCategoryProperty, out LogEventPropertyValue? value)
            && value is ScalarValue { Value: string category })
        {
            isSecurity = string.Equals(category, LoggingSettings.SecurityCategory, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        return isSecurity;
    }

    private static void ReportInternalFailure(string message)
    {
        int count = Interlocked.Increment(ref _diagnosticCount);
        if (count <= LoggingSettings.InitialDiagnosticLimit
            || count % LoggingSettings.SubsequentDiagnosticInterval == 0)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("Serilog reported a write or storage problem; some log events may be missing.");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Lobbies.Services;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Host.Matches;

internal sealed class MatchTurnClockWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan CheckInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200);
    private readonly LobbyService _lobbies;
    private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider;

    public MatchTurnClockWorker(LobbyService lobbies, TimeProvider timeProvider)
    {
        _lobbies = lobbies;
        _timeProvider = timeProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        using PeriodicTimer timer = new(CheckInterval, _timeProvider);
        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
        {
            _lobbies.ProcessExpiredMatchTurns();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Chat.Services;

public sealed class ChatLanguageFilter
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan RegexTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250);

    private static readonly string[] DefaultTerms =
    [
        "cabrón", "cabrona", "cabrones", "cabronas", "chinga", "chingada", "chingado", "chíngate", "coño",
        "estúpido", "estúpida", "gilipollas", "hijo de perra", "hija de perra", "idiota", "idiotas", "imbécil",
        "imbéciles", "mierda",
        "pendejo", "pendeja", "pendejos", "pendejas", "puta", "puto", "putas", "putos", "verga",
        "asshole", "assholes", "bitch", "bitches", "bullshit", "fuck", "fucker", "fucking", "motherfucker", "shit"
    ];

    private static readonly Regex SeparatorPattern = new(
        @"[^\p{L}\p{Nd}]+", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant, RegexTimeout);
    private static readonly Regex SpelledWordPattern = new(
        @"(?<![\p{L}\p{Nd}])[\p{L}\p{Nd}](?:[\p{P}\p{S}]+[\p{L}\p{Nd}](?![\p{L}\p{Nd}]))+",
        RegexOptions.CultureInvariant, RegexTimeout);

    private readonly string[] _blockedTerms;

    public ChatLanguageFilter(IEnumerable<string>? terms = null)
    {
        string[] configuredTerms = (terms ?? []).Select(NormalizeTerm)
            .Where(term => term.Length > 0).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
        _blockedTerms = (configuredTerms.Length > 0 ? configuredTerms : DefaultTerms.Select(NormalizeTerm))
            .Select(WithWordBoundaries).ToArray();
    }

    public bool ContainsBlockedLanguage(string message)
    {
        string spelling = NormalizeSpelling(message);
        if (MatchesBlockedTerm(spelling))
        {
            return true;
        }

        string obfuscatedSpelling = string.Concat(spelling.Select(ReplaceDigit));
        if (spelling != obfuscatedSpelling && MatchesBlockedTerm(obfuscatedSpelling))
        {
            return true;
        }

        string joined = SpelledWordPattern.Replace(obfuscatedSpelling,
            match => SeparatorPattern.Replace(match.Value, string.Empty));
        return joined != obfuscatedSpelling && MatchesBlockedTerm(joined);
    }

    private bool MatchesBlockedTerm(string spelling)
    {
        string normalizedMessage = WithWordBoundaries(SeparatorPattern.Replace(spelling, " ").Trim());
        return _blockedTerms.Any(term => normalizedMessage.Contains(term, StringComparison.Ordinal));
    }

    private static string NormalizeTerm(string text)
    {
        return SeparatorPattern.Replace(NormalizeSpelling(text), " ").Trim();
    }

    private static string NormalizeSpelling(string text)
    {
        string decomposed = text.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormKD).ToLowerInvariant()
            .Replace("n\u0303", "ñ", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return string.Concat(decomposed.Where(character => char.GetUnicodeCategory(character)
            is not (UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark or UnicodeCategory.Format)));
    }

    private static char ReplaceDigit(char character) => character switch
    {
        '0' => 'o',
        '1' => 'i',
        '3' => 'e',
        '4' => 'a',
        '5' => 's',
        '7' => 't',
        _ => character
    };

    private static string WithWordBoundaries(string text) => $" {text} ";
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Invitations.Services;

public sealed class LobbyInvitationFriendLookup
{
    private readonly IFriendshipRepository _friendshipRepository;
    private readonly IBlockedPlayerRepository _blockedPlayerRepository;

    public LobbyInvitationFriendLookup(
        IFriendshipRepository friendshipRepository,
        IBlockedPlayerRepository blockedPlayerRepository)
    {
        _friendshipRepository = friendshipRepository;
        _blockedPlayerRepository = blockedPlayerRepository;
    }

    internal List<FriendEntry> FindUnblockedFriends(Guid playerId)
    {
        List<Friendship> friendships = _friendshipRepository.GetAcceptedFriendships(playerId);
        List<FriendEntry> friends = friendships
            .Select(friendship => CreateFriendEntry(playerId, friendship))
            .ToList();
        List<Guid> friendIds = friends.Select(friend => friend.PlayerId).ToList();
        List<BlockedPlayer> blocks = _blockedPlayerRepository.GetBlocksBetween(playerId, friendIds);

        return friends
            .Where(friend => blocks.All(block =>
                block.PlayerBlockerId != friend.PlayerId && block.PlayerBlockedId != friend.PlayerId))
            .ToList();
    }

    private static FriendEntry CreateFriendEntry(Guid playerId, Friendship friendship)
    {
        Player friend = friendship.PlayerRequesterId == playerId
            ? friendship.PlayerAddressee
            : friendship.PlayerRequester;

        return new FriendEntry
        {
            PlayerId = friend.PlayerId,
            Username = friend.Username
        };
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking/Invitations/Services/LobbyInvitationOperations.cs
````csharp
using CoreWCF;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Faults;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Internal;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Invitations.Services;

public sealed class LobbyInvitationOperations
{
    private const int MaximumInvitationsPerRequest = 5;

    private readonly LobbyInvitationFriendLookup _friendLookup;
    private readonly ILobbyDirectory _lobbyDirectory;
    private readonly IFriendshipNotifier _notifier;

    public LobbyInvitationOperations(
        LobbyInvitationFriendLookup friendLookup,
        ILobbyDirectory lobbyDirectory,
        IFriendshipNotifier notifier)
    {
        _friendLookup = friendLookup;
        _lobbyDirectory = lobbyDirectory;
        _notifier = notifier;
    }

    internal List<FriendEntry> GetInvitableFriendsForPlayer(InvitableFriendsQuery request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null && request.PlayerId != Guid.Empty;

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        LobbyOverview lobby = FindLobbyOfMember(request!.LobbyCode, request.PlayerId);

        return FindInvitableFriends(request.PlayerId, lobby);
    }

    internal List<Guid> SendLobbyInvitationsForPlayer(LobbyInvitations request)
    {
        List<Guid> invitedIds = new List<Guid>();

        EnsureInvitationRequestIsValid(request);

        LobbyOverview lobby = FindLobbyOfMember(request.LobbyCode, request.SenderId);
        LobbyMember sender = lobby.Members.First(member => member.PlayerId == request.SenderId);
        int freeSlots = lobby.MaxPlayers - lobby.Members.Count;

        if (!lobby.IsWaiting)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.LobbyAlreadyStarted, ServiceMessageKeys.LobbyAlreadyStarted);
        }

        if (sender.IsGuest)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.LobbyInviteNotAllowed, ServiceMessageKeys.LobbyInviteNotAllowed);
        }

        if (freeSlots <= 0)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.LobbyFull, ServiceMessageKeys.LobbyFull);
        }

        List<FriendEntry> invitableFriends = FindInvitableFriends(request.SenderId, lobby)
            .Where(friend => request.TargetIds.Contains(friend.PlayerId))
            .ToList();

        foreach (FriendEntry friend in invitableFriends)
        {
            bool isRegistered = invitedIds.Count < freeSlots
                                && _lobbyDirectory.RegisterInvitation(lobby.LobbyCode, friend.PlayerId, sender.PlayerId);

            if (isRegistered)
            {
                invitedIds.Add(friend.PlayerId);
                _notifier.NotifyLobbyInvitationReceived(friend.PlayerId, CreateEntry(lobby, sender.Username, sender.PlayerId));
            }
        }

        return invitedIds;
    }

    internal List<LobbyInvitationEntry> GetPendingInvitationsForPlayer(Guid playerId)
    {
        List<LobbyInvitationEntry> entries = new List<LobbyInvitationEntry>();

        if (playerId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        foreach (LobbyOverview lobby in _lobbyDirectory.FindLobbiesInviting(playerId))
        {
            Guid senderId = lobby.Invitations[playerId];
            LobbyMember? sender = lobby.Members.FirstOrDefault(member => member.PlayerId == senderId)
                                  ?? lobby.Members.FirstOrDefault(member => member.PlayerId == lobby.HostPlayerId);

            entries.Add(CreateEntry(lobby, sender?.Username ?? string.Empty, senderId));
        }

        return entries;
    }

    internal bool DeclineInvitationForPlayer(LobbyInvitationDecline request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null && request.PlayerId != Guid.Empty;

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        bool isDeclined = _lobbyDirectory.CancelInvitation(request!.LobbyCode, request.PlayerId);

        return isDeclined;
    }

    private static FaultException<ServiceFault> CreateFault(string errorCode, string messageKey)
    {
        ServiceFault fault = new ServiceFault
        {
            ErrorCode = errorCode,
            MessageKey = messageKey
        };

        return new FaultException<ServiceFault>(fault, new FaultReason(errorCode));
    }

    private static void EnsureInvitationRequestIsValid(LobbyInvitations request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null
                       && request.SenderId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.TargetIds is not null
                       && request.TargetIds.Count > 0
                       && request.TargetIds.Count <= MaximumInvitationsPerRequest
                       && !request.TargetIds.Contains(request.SenderId);

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }
    }

    private static LobbyInvitationEntry CreateEntry(LobbyOverview lobby, string senderUsername, Guid senderId)
    {
        return new LobbyInvitationEntry
        {
            LobbyCode = lobby.LobbyCode,
            SenderId = senderId,
            SenderUsername = senderUsername,
            CurrentPlayers = lobby.Members.Count,
            MaxPlayers = lobby.MaxPlayers
        };
    }

    private LobbyOverview FindLobbyOfMember(string lobbyCode, Guid playerId)
    {
        LobbyOverview? lobby = _lobbyDirectory.FindLobby(lobbyCode);

        if (lobby is null)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.LobbyNotFound, ServiceMessageKeys.LobbyNotFound);
        }

        if (lobby.Members.All(member => member.PlayerId != playerId))
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.LobbyInviteNotAllowed, ServiceMessageKeys.LobbyInviteNotAllowed);
        }

        return lobby;
    }

    private List<FriendEntry> FindInvitableFriends(Guid playerId, LobbyOverview lobby)
    {
        List<FriendEntry> friends = _friendLookup.FindUnblockedFriends(playerId);

        List<FriendEntry> invitableFriends = friends
            .Where(friend => lobby.Members.All(member => member.PlayerId != friend.PlayerId))
            .Where(friend => !lobby.Invitations.ContainsKey(friend.PlayerId))
            .Where(friend => _notifier.IsOnline(friend.PlayerId))
            .Where(friend => !_lobbyDirectory.IsInAnyLobby(friend.PlayerId))
            .OrderBy(friend => friend.Username)
            .ToList();

        return invitableFriends;
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking/Lobbies/Match/LobbyMatchActivation.cs
````csharp
using Vertigo.Contracts.Internal;
using Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Lobbies;

namespace Vertigo.Server.Matchmaking.Lobbies.Match;

// The caller must hold the lobby synchronization lock during this operation.
// No asynchronous or network operations are performed by the in-process starter.
public sealed class LobbyMatchActivation
{
    private readonly IMatchSessionStarter _starter;

    public LobbyMatchActivation(IMatchSessionStarter starter)
    {
        _starter = starter;
    }

    public void Activate(LobbyState lobby)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(lobby);
        if (!lobby.CanStartMatch(lobby.HostPlayerId))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The lobby is not eligible to start a match.");
        }

        Guid[] players = lobby.GetMembersExcept(Guid.Empty).Select(member => member.PlayerId).ToArray();
        MatchStartRequest request = new()
        {
            LobbyInstanceId = lobby.LobbyInstanceId,
            LobbyCode = lobby.LobbyCode,
            HostPlayerId = lobby.HostPlayerId,
            PlayerIds = Array.AsReadOnly(players)
        };

        // If Game fails, LobbyState is unchanged and remains Waiting.
        MatchSessionSnapshot match = _starter.Start(request);
        if (match.MatchId == Guid.Empty || match.LobbyInstanceId != lobby.LobbyInstanceId
            || match.LobbyCode != lobby.LobbyCode || match.InitialHostPlayerId != lobby.HostPlayerId
            || !match.PlayerIds.SequenceEqual(players))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Game returned an inconsistent match session.");
        }

        lobby.StartMatch(match.MatchId);
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement/Authentication/Services/GuestSessionRegistry.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Vertigo.Server.CrossCutting.Security.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Services;

public sealed class GuestSessionRegistry : IGuestSessionRegistry
{
    private const int GuestDurationHours = 12;

    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, AuthenticatedSession> _sessions = new();
    private readonly ITokenGenerator _tokenGenerator;
    private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider;

    public GuestSessionRegistry(ITokenGenerator tokenGenerator, TimeProvider timeProvider)
    {
        _tokenGenerator = tokenGenerator;
        _timeProvider = timeProvider;
    }

    public AuthenticatedSession Create()
    {
        string token = _tokenGenerator.GenerateSessionToken();
        string guestCode = _tokenGenerator.GenerateVerificationCode();
        AuthenticatedSession session = new AuthenticatedSession
        {
            PlayerId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Username = $"Guest_{guestCode}",
            Token = token,
            ExpiresAt = _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime.AddHours(GuestDurationHours),
            IsGuest = true
        };

        string tokenHash = _tokenGenerator.HashSessionToken(token);
        if (!_sessions.TryAdd(tokenHash, session))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("A guest session could not be registered.");
        }

        return session;
    }

    public SessionIdentity? Find(string tokenHash)
    {
        if (!_sessions.TryGetValue(tokenHash, out AuthenticatedSession? session))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (session.ExpiresAt <= _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime)
        {
            _sessions.TryRemove(tokenHash, out _);
            return null;
        }

        return new SessionIdentity(session.PlayerId, session.Username, true);
    }

    public AuthenticatedSession? GetSession(string tokenHash)
    {
        if (Find(tokenHash) is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return _sessions.TryGetValue(tokenHash, out AuthenticatedSession? session) ? session : null;
    }

    public bool Revoke(string tokenHash)
    {
        return _sessions.TryRemove(tokenHash, out _);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Server.CrossCutting.Security.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Services;

public sealed class PlayerCredentialsVerifier
{
    private readonly IPlayerRepository _players;
    private readonly IPasswordHasher _passwordHasher;

    public PlayerCredentialsVerifier(IPlayerRepository players, IPasswordHasher passwordHasher)
    {
        _players = players;
        _passwordHasher = passwordHasher;
    }

    internal Player? FindVerifiedPlayer(string username, string password)
    {
        Player? player = _players.GetPlayerByUsername(username);
        if (player is not null && !_passwordHasher.VerifyPassword(password, player.PasswordHash, player.PasswordSalt))
        {
            player = null;
        }

        return player;
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement/Authentication/Services/RegisteredPlayerSessions.cs
````csharp
using Vertigo.Server.CrossCutting.Security.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Services;

public sealed class RegisteredPlayerSessions
{
    private const int SessionDurationDays = 7;

    private readonly ISessionTokenRepository _sessionTokens;
    private readonly ITokenGenerator _tokenGenerator;
    private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider;

    public RegisteredPlayerSessions(
        ISessionTokenRepository sessionTokens,
        ITokenGenerator tokenGenerator,
        TimeProvider timeProvider)
    {
        _sessionTokens = sessionTokens;
        _tokenGenerator = tokenGenerator;
        _timeProvider = timeProvider;
    }

    internal AuthenticatedSession Create(Player player)
    {
        string sessionToken = _tokenGenerator.GenerateSessionToken();
        DateTime now = _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;
        DateTime expiresAt = now.AddDays(SessionDurationDays);
        SessionToken token = new()
        {
            PlayerId = player.PlayerId,
            TokenValue = HashToken(sessionToken),
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt
        };

        bool isCreated = _sessionTokens.CreateSessionToken(token);
        if (!isCreated)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The session could not be persisted.");
        }

        return new AuthenticatedSession
        {
            PlayerId = player.PlayerId,
            Username = player.Username,
            Token = sessionToken,
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt
        };
    }

    internal AuthenticatedSession? Resume(string sessionToken, string tokenHash)
    {
        SessionToken? storedToken = _sessionTokens.GetActiveSessionToken(tokenHash);
        AuthenticatedSession? session = null;
        if (storedToken is not null)
        {
            session = new AuthenticatedSession
            {
                PlayerId = storedToken.PlayerId,
                Username = storedToken.Player.Username,
                Token = sessionToken,
                ExpiresAt = storedToken.ExpiresAt
            };
        }

        return session;
    }

    internal string HashToken(string sessionToken)
    {
        return _tokenGenerator.HashSessionToken(sessionToken);
    }

    internal bool Revoke(string tokenHash)
    {
        return _sessionTokens.RevokeSessionToken(tokenHash);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Services;

public class SessionService
{
    private readonly PlayerCredentialsVerifier _credentials;
    private readonly RegisteredPlayerSessions _registeredSessions;
    private readonly IGuestSessionRegistry _guests;

    public SessionService(
        PlayerCredentialsVerifier credentials,
        RegisteredPlayerSessions registeredSessions,
        IGuestSessionRegistry guests)
    {
        _credentials = credentials;
        _registeredSessions = registeredSessions;
        _guests = guests;
    }

    public AuthenticatedSession? Login(string username, string password)
    {
        AuthenticatedSession? session = null;
        Player? player = _credentials.FindVerifiedPlayer(username, password);
        if (player is not null)
        {
            session = _registeredSessions.Create(player);
        }

        return session;
    }

    public AuthenticatedSession? ResumeSession(string sessionToken)
    {
        AuthenticatedSession? session = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionToken))
        {
            string tokenHash = _registeredSessions.HashToken(sessionToken);
            session = _guests.GetSession(tokenHash);
            if (session is null)
            {
                session = _registeredSessions.Resume(sessionToken, tokenHash);
            }
        }

        return session;
    }

    public bool Logout(string sessionToken)
    {
        bool isRevoked = false;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionToken))
        {
            string tokenHash = _registeredSessions.HashToken(sessionToken);
            isRevoked = _guests.Revoke(tokenHash) || _registeredSessions.Revoke(tokenHash);
        }

        return isRevoked;
    }

    public AuthenticatedSession CreateGuestSession()
    {
        return _guests.Create();
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement/Friendships/Services/FriendshipCommands.cs
````csharp
using CoreWCF;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Faults;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Internal;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Enums;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Friendships.Services;

public sealed class FriendshipCommands
{
    private readonly FriendshipQueries _queries;
    private readonly IFriendshipRepository _friendshipRepository;
    private readonly IFriendshipNotifier _notifier;

    public FriendshipCommands(
        FriendshipQueries queries,
        IFriendshipRepository friendshipRepository,
        IFriendshipNotifier notifier)
    {
        _queries = queries;
        _friendshipRepository = friendshipRepository;
        _notifier = notifier;
    }

    internal PlayerRelation SendFriendRequestForPlayer(FriendshipInvitation request)
    {
        PlayerRelation relation = PlayerRelation.None;

        EnsureFriendRequestIsValid(request);

        Player sender = _queries.FindRegisteredPlayer(request.SenderId);
        Player target = _queries.FindRegisteredPlayer(request.TargetId);
        _queries.EnsurePlayersAreNotBlocked(request);

        Friendship? existingFriendship = _friendshipRepository.GetFriendshipBetween(request.SenderId, request.TargetId);

        if (existingFriendship is null)
        {
            relation = CreatePendingFriendship(sender, target);
        }
        else if (existingFriendship.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.AlreadyFriends, ServiceMessageKeys.AlreadyFriends);
        }
        else if (existingFriendship.PlayerRequesterId == request.SenderId)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.FriendRequestAlreadySent, ServiceMessageKeys.FriendRequestAlreadySent);
        }
        else
        {
            relation = AcceptCrossedRequest(existingFriendship, sender, target);
        }

        return relation;
    }

    internal bool DecideFriendshipForPlayer(FriendshipDecision request)
    {
        bool isResponded = false;

        EnsureResponseIsValid(request);

        Friendship? friendship = _friendshipRepository.GetFriendshipBetween(request.SenderId, request.ResponderId);
        bool isPendingForResponder = friendship is not null
                                     && friendship.Status == FriendshipStatus.Pending
                                     && friendship.PlayerRequesterId == request.SenderId;

        if (!isPendingForResponder)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.FriendRequestNotFound, ServiceMessageKeys.FriendRequestNotFound);
        }

        if (request.Accept)
        {
            isResponded = AcceptFriendRequest(request);
        }
        else
        {
            isResponded = _friendshipRepository.DeletePendingFriendship(request.SenderId, request.ResponderId);
        }

        return isResponded;
    }

    internal bool RemoveFriendshipForPlayer(PlayerPair pair)
    {
        if (pair is null || pair.PlayerId == Guid.Empty || pair.OtherPlayerId == Guid.Empty
            || pair.PlayerId == pair.OtherPlayerId)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        return _friendshipRepository.DeleteFriendshipBetween(pair.PlayerId, pair.OtherPlayerId);
    }

    private static void EnsureFriendRequestIsValid(FriendshipInvitation request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null
                       && request.SenderId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.TargetId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.SenderId != request.TargetId;

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }
    }

    private static void EnsureResponseIsValid(FriendshipDecision request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null
                       && request.ResponderId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.SenderId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.ResponderId != request.SenderId;

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }
    }

    private PlayerRelation CreatePendingFriendship(Player sender, Player target)
    {
        bool isCreated = _friendshipRepository.CreatePendingFriendship(sender.PlayerId, target.PlayerId);

        if (!isCreated)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        FriendshipInvitationEntry entry = new FriendshipInvitationEntry
        {
            SenderId = sender.PlayerId,
            SenderUsername = sender.Username
        };
        _notifier.NotifyFriendRequestReceived(target.PlayerId, entry);

        return PlayerRelation.RequestSent;
    }

    private PlayerRelation AcceptCrossedRequest(Friendship crossedFriendship, Player sender, Player target)
    {
        bool isAccepted = _friendshipRepository.AcceptPendingFriendship(
            crossedFriendship.PlayerRequesterId,
            crossedFriendship.PlayerAddresseeId);

        if (!isAccepted)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.FriendRequestNotFound, ServiceMessageKeys.FriendRequestNotFound);
        }

        _notifier.NotifyFriendshipEstablished(sender.PlayerId, FriendshipQueries.CreateFriendEntry(target));
        _notifier.NotifyFriendshipEstablished(target.PlayerId, FriendshipQueries.CreateFriendEntry(sender));

        return PlayerRelation.Friends;
    }

    private bool AcceptFriendRequest(FriendshipDecision request)
    {
        bool isAccepted = _friendshipRepository.AcceptPendingFriendship(request.SenderId, request.ResponderId);

        if (isAccepted)
        {
            Player responder = _queries.FindRegisteredPlayer(request.ResponderId);
            _notifier.NotifyFriendshipEstablished(request.SenderId, FriendshipQueries.CreateFriendEntry(responder));
        }

        return isAccepted;
    }

    private static FaultException<ServiceFault> CreateFault(string errorCode, string messageKey)
    {
        ServiceFault fault = new ServiceFault
        {
            ErrorCode = errorCode,
            MessageKey = messageKey
        };

        return new FaultException<ServiceFault>(fault, new FaultReason(errorCode));
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Contracts.Internal;
using CoreWCF;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Callbacks;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Faults;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Friendships.Services;

[ServiceBehavior(InstanceContextMode = InstanceContextMode.Single, ConcurrencyMode = ConcurrencyMode.Multiple)]
public sealed class FriendshipNotificationService : IFriendshipNotificationService
{
    private readonly IFriendshipNotifier _notifier;
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

    public FriendshipNotificationService(IFriendshipNotifier notifier, IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
    {
        _notifier = notifier;
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
    }

    public bool Subscribe(string sessionToken)
    {
        using IServiceScope scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
        ISessionIdentityResolver resolver = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ISessionIdentityResolver>();
        SessionIdentity identity = resolver.RequireRegistered(sessionToken);

        IFriendshipCallback callback = OperationContext.Current.GetCallbackChannel<IFriendshipCallback>();
        IContextChannel channel = (IContextChannel)callback;
        string sessionId = OperationContext.Current.SessionId ?? string.Empty;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionId))
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.Unauthorized, ServiceMessageKeys.Unauthorized);
        }

        _notifier.Subscribe(identity.PlayerId, callback, sessionId);

        channel.Closed -= OnChannelClosed;
        channel.Faulted -= OnChannelClosed;
        channel.Closed += OnChannelClosed;
        channel.Faulted += OnChannelClosed;

        return true;
    }

    public void Unsubscribe()
    {
        string sessionId = OperationContext.Current.SessionId ?? string.Empty;
        _notifier.UnsubscribeSession(sessionId);
    }

    private void OnChannelClosed(object? sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
    {
        string sessionId = (sender as IContextChannel)?.SessionId ?? string.Empty;

        _notifier.UnsubscribeSession(sessionId);
    }

    private static FaultException<ServiceFault> CreateFault(string errorCode, string messageKey)
    {
        ServiceFault fault = new ServiceFault
        {
            ErrorCode = errorCode,
            MessageKey = messageKey
        };

        return new FaultException<ServiceFault>(fault, new FaultReason(errorCode));
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement/Friendships/Services/FriendshipQueries.cs
````csharp
using CoreWCF;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Faults;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Enums;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Friendships.Services;

public sealed class FriendshipQueries
{
    private const int MinimumSearchLength = 3;
    private const int MaximumSearchResults = 20;

    private readonly IPlayerRepository _playerRepository;
    private readonly IFriendshipRepository _friendshipRepository;
    private readonly IBlockedPlayerRepository _blockedPlayerRepository;

    public FriendshipQueries(
        IPlayerRepository playerRepository,
        IFriendshipRepository friendshipRepository,
        IBlockedPlayerRepository blockedPlayerRepository)
    {
        _playerRepository = playerRepository;
        _friendshipRepository = friendshipRepository;
        _blockedPlayerRepository = blockedPlayerRepository;
    }

    internal List<FriendEntry> GetFriendsForPlayer(Guid playerId)
    {
        List<FriendEntry> entries = new List<FriendEntry>();

        if (playerId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        List<Friendship> friendships = _friendshipRepository.GetAcceptedFriendships(playerId);

        foreach (Friendship friendship in friendships)
        {
            entries.Add(CreateFriendEntry(playerId, friendship));
        }

        return entries.OrderBy(entry => entry.Username).ToList();
    }

    internal List<PlayerSearchEntry> SearchPlayersForPlayer(PlayerSearch request)
    {
        List<PlayerSearchEntry> entries = new List<PlayerSearchEntry>();

        EnsureSearchRequestIsValid(request);

        string searchTerm = request.SearchTerm.Trim();
        List<Player> players = _playerRepository.SearchPlayersByUsername(
            searchTerm,
            request.RequesterId,
            MaximumSearchResults);
        List<Guid> playerIds = players.Select(player => player.PlayerId).ToList();
        List<BlockedPlayer> blocks = _blockedPlayerRepository.GetBlocksBetween(request.RequesterId, playerIds);
        List<Friendship> friendships = _friendshipRepository.GetFriendshipsBetween(request.RequesterId, playerIds);

        foreach (Player player in players)
        {
            bool hasBlockedRequester = blocks.Any(block => block.PlayerBlockerId == player.PlayerId);

            if (!hasBlockedRequester)
            {
                PlayerPair pair = new() { PlayerId = request.RequesterId, OtherPlayerId = player.PlayerId };
                PlayerRelation relation = ResolveRelation(pair, blocks, friendships);
                entries.Add(CreateSearchEntry(player, relation));
            }
        }

        return entries;
    }

    internal List<FriendshipInvitationEntry> GetPendingRequestsForPlayer(Guid playerId)
    {
        List<FriendshipInvitationEntry> entries = new List<FriendshipInvitationEntry>();

        if (playerId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        List<Friendship> pendingFriendships = _friendshipRepository.GetPendingRequestsReceivedBy(playerId);

        foreach (Friendship friendship in pendingFriendships)
        {
            entries.Add(CreateRequestEntry(friendship));
        }

        return entries;
    }

    internal Player FindRegisteredPlayer(Guid playerId)
    {
        Player? player = _playerRepository.GetPlayerById(playerId);

        if (player is null)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.UserNotFound, ServiceMessageKeys.UserNotFound);
        }

        return player;
    }

    internal void EnsurePlayersAreNotBlocked(FriendshipInvitation request)
    {
        List<Guid> targetIds = new List<Guid> { request.TargetId };
        List<BlockedPlayer> blocks = _blockedPlayerRepository.GetBlocksBetween(request.SenderId, targetIds);

        if (blocks.Count > 0)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.FriendshipBlocked, ServiceMessageKeys.FriendshipBlocked);
        }
    }

    private static PlayerRelation ResolveRelation(
        PlayerPair pair,
        List<BlockedPlayer> blocks,
        List<Friendship> friendships)
    {
        PlayerRelation relation = PlayerRelation.None;

        bool isBlockedByRequester = blocks.Any(
            block => block.PlayerBlockerId == pair.PlayerId && block.PlayerBlockedId == pair.OtherPlayerId);
        Friendship? friendship = friendships.FirstOrDefault(
            candidate => candidate.PlayerRequesterId == pair.OtherPlayerId
                || candidate.PlayerAddresseeId == pair.OtherPlayerId);

        if (isBlockedByRequester)
        {
            relation = PlayerRelation.Blocked;
        }
        else if (friendship is not null && friendship.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
        {
            relation = PlayerRelation.Friends;
        }
        else if (friendship is not null && friendship.PlayerRequesterId == pair.PlayerId)
        {
            relation = PlayerRelation.RequestSent;
        }

        return relation;
    }

    private static PlayerSearchEntry CreateSearchEntry(Player player, PlayerRelation relation)
    {
        return new PlayerSearchEntry
        {
            PlayerId = player.PlayerId,
            Username = player.Username,
            Relation = relation
        };
    }

    private static FriendshipInvitationEntry CreateRequestEntry(Friendship friendship)
    {
        return new FriendshipInvitationEntry
        {
            SenderId = friendship.PlayerRequesterId,
            SenderUsername = friendship.PlayerRequester.Username
        };
    }

    private static void EnsureSearchRequestIsValid(PlayerSearch request)
    {
        bool isValid = request is not null
                       && request.RequesterId != Guid.Empty
                       && request.SearchTerm is not null
                       && request.SearchTerm.Trim().Length >= MinimumSearchLength;

        if (!isValid)
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }
    }

    private static FriendEntry CreateFriendEntry(Guid playerId, Friendship friendship)
    {
        Player friend = friendship.PlayerRequesterId == playerId
            ? friendship.PlayerAddressee
            : friendship.PlayerRequester;

        return CreateFriendEntry(friend);
    }

    internal static FriendEntry CreateFriendEntry(Player player)
    {
        return new FriendEntry
        {
            PlayerId = player.PlayerId,
            Username = player.Username
        };
    }

    private static FaultException<ServiceFault> CreateFault(string errorCode, string messageKey)
    {
        ServiceFault fault = new ServiceFault
        {
            ErrorCode = errorCode,
            MessageKey = messageKey
        };

        return new FaultException<ServiceFault>(fault, new FaultReason(errorCode));
    }
}
````

````csharp
using CoreWCF;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Faults;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Authentication.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Registration.Services;

public sealed class AccountPasswordService
{
    private const string EventCategoryProperty = "EventCategory";
    private const string SecurityCategory = "Security";
    private const string SucceededResult = "Succeeded";
    private const string RejectedResult = "Rejected";

    private static readonly EventId PasswordChangeSucceededEvent = new(2101, "PasswordChangeSucceeded");
    private static readonly EventId PasswordChangeRejectedEvent = new(2102, "PasswordChangeRejected");

    private readonly AccountPasswordStore _passwordStore;
    private readonly ISessionIdentityResolver _sessions;
    private readonly ILogger<AccountService> _logger;

    public AccountPasswordService(
        AccountPasswordStore passwordStore,
        ISessionIdentityResolver sessions,
        ILogger<AccountService> logger)
    {
        _passwordStore = passwordStore;
        _sessions = sessions;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public bool ChangePassword(PasswordChange change, string sessionToken)
    {
        if (change is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(change.Username)
            || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(change.CurrentPassword)
            || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(change.NewPassword))
        {
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidData, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidData);
        }

        SessionIdentity identity = _sessions.RequireRegistered(sessionToken);
        PasswordChangeOutcome outcome = _passwordStore.TryChange(identity.PlayerId, change);
        if (outcome == PasswordChangeOutcome.InvalidCredentials)
        {
            LogPasswordChange(PasswordChangeRejectedEvent, RejectedResult, identity.PlayerId);
            throw CreateFault(ServiceErrorCodes.InvalidCredentials, ServiceMessageKeys.InvalidCredentials);
        }

        bool isChanged = outcome == PasswordChangeOutcome.Updated;
        if (isChanged)
        {
            LogPasswordChange(PasswordChangeSucceededEvent, SucceededResult, identity.PlayerId);
        }

        return isChanged;
    }

    private void LogPasswordChange(EventId eventId, string result, Guid playerId)
    {
        Dictionary<string, object> properties = new()
        {
            [EventCategoryProperty] = SecurityCategory
        };

        using (IDisposable? scope = _logger.BeginScope(properties))
        {
            _logger.LogInformation(eventId, "Password change {Result}. PlayerId: {PlayerId}", result, playerId);
        }
    }

    private static FaultException<ServiceFault> CreateFault(string errorCode, string messageKey)
    {
        ServiceFault fault = new ServiceFault { ErrorCode = errorCode, MessageKey = messageKey };
        return new FaultException<ServiceFault>(fault, new FaultReason(errorCode));
    }
}
````

## File: src/Server/Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement/Registration/Services/AccountPasswordStore.cs
````csharp
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Vertigo.Server.CrossCutting.Security.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Entities.Identity;
using Vertigo.Server.DataAccess.Repositories.Interfaces;

namespace Vertigo.Server.PlayerManagement.Registration.Services;

public sealed class AccountPasswordStore
{
    private readonly IPlayerRepository _players;
    private readonly IPasswordHasher _passwordHasher;

    public AccountPasswordStore(
        IPlayerRepository players,
        IPasswordHasher passwordHasher)
    {
        _players = players;
        _passwordHasher = passwordHasher;
    }

    internal PasswordChangeOutcome TryChange(Guid playerId, PasswordChange change)
    {
        Player? player = _players.GetPlayerById(playerId);
        PasswordChangeOutcome outcome = PasswordChangeOutcome.InvalidCredentials;
        if (player is not null
            && string.Equals(player.Username, change.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            && _passwordHasher.VerifyPassword(change.CurrentPassword, player.PasswordHash, player.PasswordSalt))
        {
            string salt = _passwordHasher.GenerateSalt();
            string hash = _passwordHasher.HashPassword(change.NewPassword, salt);
            bool isChanged = _players.UpdatePasswordAndRevokeSessions(player.PlayerId, hash, salt);
            outcome = isChanged ? PasswordChangeOutcome.Updated : PasswordChangeOutcome.NotUpdated;
        }

        return outcome;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Contracts.Callbacks;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Contracts.Internal;

public interface IFriendshipNotifier
{
    void Subscribe(Guid playerId, IFriendshipCallback callback, string sessionId);
````

## File: src/Shared/Vertigo.Contracts/Models/MatchChatRules.cs
````csharp
namespace Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

public static class MatchChatRules
{
    public const int MaximumLength = 30;

    public static bool CanSend(string? message)
    {
        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message) && message.Length <= MaximumLength
            && !message.Contains('\r') && !message.Contains('\n');
    }
}
````

## File: tests/Vertigo.Client.Networking.Smoke/Program.cs
````csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Vertigo.Client.Core.Navigation;
using Vertigo.Client.Core.Sessions;
using Vertigo.Client.Networking;
using Vertigo.Client.Networking.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Client.Networking.Results;
using Vertigo.Client.Networking.Sessions.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

ServiceCollection registrations = new();
registrations.AddVertigoClientNetworking();
using ServiceProvider services = registrations.BuildServiceProvider();
ISessionCoordinator authentication = services.GetRequiredService<ISessionCoordinator>();
PlayerSession session = services.GetRequiredService<PlayerSession>();
INavigator navigation = services.GetRequiredService<INavigator>();

string mode = args.Length > 0 ? args[0].ToLowerInvariant() : "guest";
ClientResult<UserSession> login;
if (mode == "login" && args.Length == 3)
{
    login = authentication.Login(args[1], args[2]);
}
else if (mode == "guest")
{
    login = authentication.CreateGuestSession();
}
else
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine("Usage: dotnet run -- guest OR dotnet run -- login USERNAME PASSWORD");
    return 2;
}

if (!login.IsSuccess || login.Value is null)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"Login failed: {login.Failure}, {login.ErrorCode}");
    return 1;
}

SessionSnapshot? active = session.GetActiveSession();
if (active is null)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine("The session was not stored locally.");
    return 1;
}

Console.WriteLine($"Authenticated: {active.Username} (Guest={active.IsGuest})");
Console.WriteLine("Token received: YES (value not printed)");
navigation.NavigateTo(NavigationPage.Home);
Console.WriteLine($"Navigation: {navigation.CurrentPage}");

using ILobbyClient lobby = services.GetRequiredService<ILobbyClient>();
lobby.PlayerJoined += (_, member) => Console.WriteLine($"Joined: {member.Username}");
lobby.MessageReceived += (_, message) => Console.WriteLine($"Chat: {message.SenderUsername}: {message.Text}");

int exitCode = 0;
try
{
    string lobbyCode = lobby.CreateLobby(true, 2, active.Token);
    Console.WriteLine($"Lobby created: {lobbyCode}");
    navigation.NavigateTo(NavigationPage.Lobby);
    IChatClient chat = services.GetRequiredService<IChatClient>();
    ClientResult<bool> sent = chat.SendMessage(lobbyCode, "Hello from Vertigo smoke test", active.Token);
    Console.WriteLine($"Chat sent: {sent.IsSuccess && sent.Value} ({sent.Failure})");
    bool left = lobby.LeaveLobby(lobbyCode, active.Token);
    Console.WriteLine($"Lobby left: {left}");
    if (!sent.IsSuccess || !sent.Value || !left)
    {
        exitCode = 1;
    }
}
catch (Exception exception)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"Lobby transport/business failure: {exception.GetType().Name}: {exception.Message}");
    exitCode = 1;
}
finally
{
    ClientResult<bool> logout = authentication.Logout();
    bool isLoggedOut = logout.IsSuccess && logout.Value && !session.IsAuthenticated;
    Console.WriteLine($"Logout: {isLoggedOut} ({logout.Failure})");
    if (!isLoggedOut)
    {
        exitCode = 1;
    }
}

return exitCode;
````

## File: tests/Vertigo.Client.UnitTests/Lobbies/LobbyCallbackHandlerTests.cs
````csharp
using System.Reflection;
using System.ServiceModel;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Vertigo.Client.Networking.Callbacks;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Callbacks;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Lobbies;

public sealed class LobbyCallbackHandlerTests
{
    private const string LobbyCode = "ABC123";
    private const string ChatText = "Hello";
    private const long BoardRevision = 6;

    private readonly List<object> _received = new();
    private readonly ILobbyCallback _callback;

    public LobbyCallbackHandlerTests()
    {
        LobbyCallbackHandler handler = new();
        handler.PlayerJoined += CapturePayload;
        handler.PlayerLeft += CapturePlayerLeft;
        handler.MessageReceived += CapturePayload;
        handler.PreparationChanged += CapturePayload;
        handler.MatchBoardUpdated += CapturePayload;
        _callback = handler;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Notify_SerializedNotifications_RaisesExpectedEventsInOrder()
    {
        Guid playerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid matchId = Guid.NewGuid();
        LobbyNotification[] notifications = CreateNotifications(playerId, matchId);

        foreach (LobbyNotification notification in notifications)
        {
            _callback.Notify(RoundTrip(notification));
        }

        Assert.Equal(notifications.Length, _received.Count);
        LobbyMember joined = Assert.IsType<LobbyMember>(_received[0]);
        Guid leftPlayerId = Assert.IsType<Guid>(_received[1]);
        LobbyChatMessage chat = Assert.IsType<LobbyChatMessage>(_received[2]);
        LobbyPreparation preparation = Assert.IsType<LobbyPreparation>(_received[3]);
        MatchBoardChanged boardChange = Assert.IsType<MatchBoardChanged>(_received[4]);
        Assert.Equal(playerId, joined.PlayerId);
        Assert.Equal(playerId, leftPlayerId);
        Assert.Equal(ChatText, chat.Text);
        Assert.Equal(LobbyCode, preparation.LobbyCode);
        Assert.Equal(matchId, boardChange.MatchId);
        Assert.Equal(BoardRevision, boardChange.Revision);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Notify_PayloadDoesNotMatchKind_RaisesNoEvents()
    {
        LobbyNotification notification = new()
        {
            Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.MatchBoardUpdated,
            Preparation = new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = LobbyCode }
        };

        _callback.Notify(RoundTrip(notification));

        Assert.Empty(_received);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LobbyCallback_Contract_DeclaresOneTypedOneWayOperation()
    {
        MethodInfo method = Assert.Single(typeof(ILobbyCallback).GetMethods());

        Assert.Equal(nameof(ILobbyCallback.Notify), method.Name);
        Assert.True(method.GetCustomAttribute<OperationContractAttribute>()?.IsOneWay);
        Assert.Equal(typeof(void), method.ReturnType);
        Assert.Equal(typeof(LobbyNotification), Assert.Single(method.GetParameters()).ParameterType);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(LobbyNotificationKind.None, null)]
    [InlineData(LobbyNotificationKind.PreparationChanged, null)]
    [InlineData(LobbyNotificationKind.PlayerLeft, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")]
    public void Notify_MissingOrInvalidPayload_RaisesNoEvents(LobbyNotificationKind kind, string? playerId)
    {
        LobbyNotification notification = new()
        {
            Kind = kind,
            LeftPlayerId = playerId is null ? null : Guid.Parse(playerId)
        };

        _callback.Notify(RoundTrip(notification));

        Assert.Empty(_received);
    }

    private void CapturePayload(object? sender, object payload)
    {
        _received.Add(payload);
    }

    private void CapturePlayerLeft(object? sender, Guid playerId)
    {
        _received.Add(playerId);
    }

    private static LobbyNotification[] CreateNotifications(Guid playerId, Guid matchId)
    {
        return new LobbyNotification[]
        {
            new()
            {
                Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.PlayerJoined,
                JoinedPlayer = new LobbyMember { PlayerId = playerId }
            },
            new()
            {
                Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.PlayerLeft,
                LeftPlayerId = playerId
            },
            new()
            {
                Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.MessageReceived,
                ChatMessage = new LobbyChatMessage { LobbyCode = LobbyCode, Text = ChatText }
            },
            new()
            {
                Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.PreparationChanged,
                Preparation = new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = LobbyCode }
            },
            new()
            {
                Kind = LobbyNotificationKind.MatchBoardUpdated,
                BoardChange = new MatchBoardChanged
                {
                    LobbyCode = LobbyCode,
                    MatchId = matchId,
                    PlayerUsername = "player",
                    Revision = BoardRevision
                }
            }
        };
    }

    private static LobbyNotification RoundTrip(LobbyNotification notification)
    {
        DataContractSerializer serializer = new(typeof(LobbyNotification));
        using MemoryStream stream = new();
        serializer.WriteObject(stream, notification);
        stream.Position = 0;

        return Assert.IsType<LobbyNotification>(serializer.ReadObject(stream));
    }
}
````

## File: tests/Vertigo.Client.UnitTests/Lobbies/LobbyPreparationRevisionTests.cs
````csharp
using Vertigo.Client.UI.ViewModels.Lifecycle;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Lobbies;

public sealed class LobbyPreparationRevisionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_OutOfOrderUpdates_KeepsNewest()
    {
        LobbyPreparationRevision tracker = new();
        LobbyPreparation newer = new() { LobbyCode = "ABCDEF", Revision = 12 };
        LobbyPreparation older = new() { LobbyCode = "ABCDEF", Revision = 11 };

        Assert.True(tracker.TryAdvance(newer, "ABCDEF"));
        Assert.False(tracker.TryAdvance(older, "ABCDEF"));
        Assert.False(tracker.TryAdvance(newer, "ABCDEF"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_AfterLeavingRoom_DiscardsQueuedUpdate()
    {
        LobbyPreparationRevision tracker = new();
        LobbyPreparation queued = new() { LobbyCode = "ABCDEF", Revision = 5 };
        tracker.TryAdvance(new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = "ABCDEF", Revision = 4 }, "ABCDEF");
        tracker.Reset();

        Assert.False(tracker.TryAdvance(queued, string.Empty));
        Assert.True(tracker.TryAdvance(new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = "GHIJKL", Revision = 1 }, "GHIJKL"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_AnotherRoom_DoesNotAdvanceRevision()
    {
        LobbyPreparationRevision tracker = new();
        Assert.False(tracker.TryAdvance(new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = "OLD", Revision = 50 }, "NEW"));
        Assert.True(tracker.TryAdvance(new LobbyPreparation { LobbyCode = "NEW", Revision = 1 }, "NEW"));
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.ServiceModel;
using Vertigo.Client.UI.Utilities.Localization.Interfaces;
using Vertigo.Client.UI.Utilities.Localization.Services;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Xunit;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Matches;

public sealed class MatchBoardErrorHandlingTests
{
    private readonly ClientErrorText _errors = new(new KeyLocalizer());

    [Fact]
    public void FromException_Timeout_ReturnsTimeoutMessage()
    {
        string actual = _errors.FromException(new TimeoutException(), "Error.Unknown");

        Assert.Equal("Error.Timeout", actual);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FromException_NetworkFailure_ReturnsConnectionMessage()
    {
        string actual = _errors.FromException(new EndpointNotFoundException("Test endpoint unavailable."), "Error.Unknown");

        Assert.Equal("Error.Connection", actual);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FromException_BusinessFault_ReturnsServerMessageKey()
    {
        ServiceFault detail = new()
        {
            ErrorCode = "LOBBY_NOT_FOUND",
            MessageKey = "Lobby.NotFound"
        };
        FaultException<ServiceFault> fault = new(detail, new FaultReason("Lobby not found"));

        string actual = _errors.FromException(fault, "Error.Unknown");

        Assert.Equal("Lobby.NotFound", actual);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FromException_UnexpectedFailure_ReturnsGenericError()
    {
        string actual = _errors.FromException(new InvalidOperationException(), "Error.Unknown");

        Assert.Equal("Error.Unknown", actual);
    }

    private sealed class KeyLocalizer : ITextLocalizer
    {
        public string Get(string key)
        {
            return key;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Client.UI.ViewModels.Lifecycle;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;
using Xunit;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Matches;

public sealed class MatchBoardRevisionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_NewerRevision_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        MatchBoardRevision revisions = new();
        Guid matchId = Guid.NewGuid();

        bool result = revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot
        {
            MatchId = matchId,
            Revision = 2
        }, matchId);

        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_OlderRevision_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        MatchBoardRevision revisions = new();
        Guid matchId = Guid.NewGuid();
        revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot { MatchId = matchId, Revision = 4 }, matchId);

        bool result = revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot
        {
            MatchId = matchId,
            Revision = 3
        }, matchId);

        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_DifferentMatch_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        MatchBoardRevision revisions = new();

        bool result = revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot
        {
            MatchId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Revision = 2
        }, Guid.NewGuid());

        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAdvance_Reset_AllowsNewMatch()
    {
        MatchBoardRevision revisions = new();
        Guid first = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid next = Guid.NewGuid();
        revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot { MatchId = first, Revision = 3 }, first);
        revisions.Reset();

        bool result = revisions.TryAdvance(new MatchBoardSnapshot
        {
            MatchId = next,
            Revision = 1
        }, next);

        Assert.True(result);
    }
}
````

## File: tests/Vertigo.Client.UnitTests/Matches/MatchExpulsionVotingTests.cs
````csharp
using Vertigo.Client.UI.ViewModels.Presentation;
using Vertigo.Contracts.Models;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Matches;

public sealed class MatchExpulsionVotingTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CanVoteFor_ActiveLocalPlayer_CanVoteOutsideOwnTurnAndCannotVoteForSelf()
    {
        MatchExpulsionVoting voting = new();
        Guid localId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid targetId = Guid.NewGuid();
        MatchBoardSnapshot board = CreateBoard(localId, targetId, Guid.NewGuid());

        voting.ApplyBoard(board, localId);
        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(CreateHand(board, localId));

        Assert.NotEqual(localId, board.CurrentTurnPlayerId);
        Assert.True(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(localId));
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(Guid.NewGuid()));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ApplyPrivateHand_PreviousVoteAfterReconnect_DisablesOnlyThatTarget()
    {
        MatchExpulsionVoting voting = new();
        Guid localId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid targetId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid otherId = Guid.NewGuid();
        MatchBoardSnapshot board = CreateBoard(localId, targetId, otherId);
        board.ExpulsionVotes.Add(new MatchExpulsionVoteSummary { TargetPlayerId = targetId, VoteCount = 1 });

        voting.ApplyBoard(board, localId);
        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(CreateHand(board, localId, targetId));

        Assert.True(voting.IsEligibleTarget(targetId));
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));
        Assert.True(voting.CanVoteFor(otherId));
        Assert.Equal(1, voting.GetVoteCount(targetId));
        Assert.Equal(2, voting.RequiredVotes);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanVoteFor_TwoPlayersOrMatchFinished_IsUnavailable()
    {
        MatchExpulsionVoting voting = new();
        Guid localId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid targetId = Guid.NewGuid();
        MatchBoardSnapshot twoPlayers = CreateBoard(localId, targetId);
        voting.ApplyBoard(twoPlayers, localId);
        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(CreateHand(twoPlayers, localId));
        Assert.False(voting.IsEligibleTarget(targetId));
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));

        MatchBoardSnapshot finished = CreateBoard(localId, targetId, Guid.NewGuid());
        finished.EndReason = MatchEndReason.Completed;
        voting.ApplyBoard(finished, localId);
        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(CreateHand(finished, localId));
        Assert.False(voting.IsEligibleTarget(targetId));
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ApplyPrivateHand_DifferentVotingRevision_WaitsForCurrentPrivateState()
    {
        MatchExpulsionVoting voting = new();
        Guid localId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Guid targetId = Guid.NewGuid();
        MatchBoardSnapshot board = CreateBoard(localId, targetId, Guid.NewGuid());
        board.VotingRevision = 1;
        MatchPrivateHand stale = CreateHand(board, localId);
        stale.VotingRevision = 0;

        voting.ApplyBoard(board, localId);
        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(stale);
        Assert.False(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));

        voting.ApplyPrivateHand(CreateHand(board, localId));
        Assert.True(voting.CanVoteFor(targetId));
    }

    private static MatchBoardSnapshot CreateBoard(params Guid[] players)
    {
        return new MatchBoardSnapshot
        {
            MatchId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CurrentTurnPlayerId = players[1],
            TurnDeadlineUtc = DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch.AddSeconds(20),
            Players = players.Select(id => new MatchBoardPlayer { PlayerId = id }).ToList(),
            ExpulsionVotesRequired = players.Length / 2 + 1
        };
    }

    private static MatchPrivateHand CreateHand(MatchBoardSnapshot board, Guid playerId, params Guid[] votedTargets)
    {
        return new MatchPrivateHand
        {
            MatchId = board.MatchId,
            PlayerId = playerId,
            VotingRevision = board.VotingRevision,
            VotedExpulsionTargetIds = votedTargets.ToList()
        };
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Vertigo.Client.UI.ViewModels.Presentation;

namespace Vertigo.Client.UnitTests.Matches;

public sealed class MatchMasterPlanDraftTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void TryAppend_ValidModules_UsesSelectionOrderAndRequiresTwoModules()
    {
        MatchMasterPlanDraft draft = new();

        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 15));
        Assert.False(draft.CanPlay);
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 24));
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 32));

        Assert.True(draft.CanPlay);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { 15, 24, 32 }, draft.Modules);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryAppend_DuplicateOrInvalidRise_KeepsTheExistingDraft()
    {
        MatchMasterPlanDraft draft = new();
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 15));

        Assert.False(draft.TryAppend(12, 15));
        Assert.False(draft.TryAppend(12, 26));
        Assert.False(draft.TryAppend(12, 14));
        Assert.False(draft.TryAppend(null, 20));

        Assert.Equal(new[] { 15 }, draft.Modules);
        Assert.False(draft.CanPlay);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RemoveLast_ChangesChainTopSoAnotherModuleCanBeAdded()
    {
        MatchMasterPlanDraft draft = new();
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 15));
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 24));

        bool removed = draft.RemoveLast();

        Assert.True(removed);
        Assert.False(draft.CanPlay);
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 20));
        Assert.Equal(new[] { 15, 20 }, draft.Modules);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsStillInHand_MissingModule_InvalidatesDraft()
    {
        MatchMasterPlanDraft draft = new();
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 15));
        Assert.True(draft.TryAppend(12, 20));

        Assert.False(draft.IsStillInHand(new[] { 15, 26 }));
        Assert.True(draft.IsStillInHand(new[] { 20, 15 }));

        draft.Clear();
        Assert.Empty(draft.Modules);
        Assert.False(draft.CanPlay);
    }
}
````
